description: Create a fresh PrivatePAY x402 v2 challenge for a resource and quoted USDC amount. Call this before privatepay_verify; it returns exact payment requirements and the PDAO private-settlement rule, but never signs, broadcasts, or charges a wallet.

inputSchema.description: Create a fresh PrivatePAY x402 v2 challenge after checking rail status. This returns payment requirements and the PDAO private-settlement rule; it does not sign, broadcast, or move funds.

amount_base_units.description: Quoted USDC amount in token base units, not a decimal display amount.

mime_type.description: Optional response media type for the purchased resource.

nonce.description: Optional caller nonce used to bind a fresh challenge.

resource.description: Stable HTTPS resource or service identifier being purchased.

name: privatepay_challenge

outputSchema.description: Structured PrivatePAY x402 challenge and payment requirements.

payment_required.description: Exact x402 v2 requirements to present to the payer.

payment_required_header.description: HTTP PAYMENT-REQUIRED value when returned by the checkout flow.

privacy.description: Redacted privacy boundary for the challenge.

request_id.description: Fresh challenge or payment request identifier.

title: PrivateDAO Payment Challenge
